protocol.warmup: one batch at the calibrated size
protocol.order: per configuration, implementations interleaved repetition by repetition with a rotating first position (reps[].position); configurations in the order listed
protocol.batchCap: calibrated to 1,000 calls or fewer; a warm-up batch over 2 s shrinks the batch to 90% of the cap and warms up again (warmupMs lists each attempt)

inputs.a: makeFullDirectory(groups): 100 principals (10 humans, 90 digital employees), 100 sites, 100 workspaces, 100 pools, 100 nodes each serving 100 pools; each group has 100 members and binds 100 workspaces, 100 pools and 100 nodes
inputs.b: makePreviewInput(nodes): 10 sites, 20 principals, 5 workspaces, 5 pools, 10 groups; all nodes bound to group 0 and serving pool0, sites and readiness seeded; eligible request from site0
